title: Group Fitness Class Passes: credits granted, class duration, class types allowed and instructor tier
content:
## Scope
This document covers the Group Fitness Class Passes product line. For each class-credit pack tier, it states the number of class credits the pack grants at purchase, the typical length of a booked class, which class types the pack's credits may book, and the qualification level of the instructors leading those classes.

## Basis by tier
Each tier grants a fixed count of class credits at purchase, except the Unlimited Monthly Classes tier, whose credit count is represented as unlimited rather than a finite number. Each tier also fixes which class types its credits may book: basic class types only, all class types, or specialty class types only. Each tier fixes the typical duration of a booked class and the qualification tier of the instructors leading that tier's classes.

| Tier | Credits included | Typical class duration | Class types allowed | Instructor tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 5-Class Pack | 5 | 45 minutes | Basic only | Standard |
| 10-Class Pack | 10 | 45 minutes | Basic only | Standard |
| 20-Class Pack | 20 | 50 minutes | All | Standard |
| Unlimited Monthly Classes | Unlimited (recorded as -1) | 45 minutes | All | Standard |
| Specialty Studio Pack | 10 | 60 minutes | Specialty only | Master |
| Founding Class Pass | 15 | 50 minutes | All | Standard |

## Points of judgement
- Only the Specialty Studio Pack is led exclusively by master-tier instructors and restricted to specialty class types only; every other tier is led by standard-tier instructors.
- The Unlimited Monthly Classes tier grants no fixed credit count; its pack is usable without drawing down a finite credit balance, in contrast to every other tier.
